liner.body_md:
## The recordings

- **gd1989-12-31.142693.fob.bk4011.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 173 min [1]
- **gd1989-12-31.165046.mtx.seamons.ht161.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 169 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1989-12-31.sbd.gillis.gorinsky.6116.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 2/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1989-12-31.155442.UltraMatrix.sbd.broadcast-mix.cm.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 166 min [4]. Said about its sound: The mix changes throughout, with the ambient microphone frequently turned off [4]
- **gd89-12-31.prefm.miller.23574.sbeok.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 20 songs; 170 min; rated 3.56/5 by 9 [8]. Said about its sound: High levels cause clipping, making Sunshine Daydream almost unusable; Kuck improved distortion by pulling down band widths using EQ; This recording runs at 200 kps with higher volume and crisper sound [19][23][26]
- **gd89-12-31.sbd.bertha-ashley.18674.sbeok.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 20 songs; 153 min; rated 3.5/5 by 14 [13]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is good but not great, with a distinct coliseum atmosphere; Shakedown Street vocals were a bit sloppy at times [21][28]

## Around the show

- Bonnie Raitt performed Big Boss Man with the band [1]
- Taro Hart joined the band for Iko Iko [2]
- Airto Moreira played drums from Victim through Drums [2]
- Bonnie Raitt sang Not Fade Away, which included a theme, verse, and spacey section [3]
- Mickey used weird echo metal slapper noise to keep the beat all night [21]
- Jerry played straight guitar whining during the space section [21]
- The band followed the muse deeply during a half-length Dark Star [22]
- The audience agreed it was a hot show despite limited old tunes [25]
- Fans were disappointed the band played only Dark Star from their recent repertoire [25]
- Playing Iko Iko two nights in a row was unusual for this run [27]
- The reviewer prefers night two to this show, though it is good [27]
- The 12-28-89 show is needed to complete this New Year's run [30]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-12-31.142693.fob.bk4011.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Master (FOB)Audience Dat; B&K 4011 mics (ORTF, 110 degrees)(16-bit/48k); Transfer Info: Dat (Sony PCM-R500)> Tascam DA-3000… [1]
- **gd1989-12-31.165046.mtx.seamons.ht161.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) July… [2]. Also: Jeff Bowen's recording patched 1:31 of Women Are Smarter in the audience source [2]
- **gd1989-12-31.sbd.gillis.gorinsky.6116.shnf**: taped by Glenn Gillis; transferred by G. Gorinsky; source: FMS > DAT > CDR > EAC (secure mode, test and copy) > SHN [3]. Also: Glenn Gillis contributed the show; G.Gorinsky handled EAC, SHN extraction, and seeding [3]
- **gd1989-12-31.155442.UltraMatrix.sbd.broadcast-mix.cm.miller.t.flac16**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 28, 2021; source: UltraMatrix SBD (Broadcast Mix) > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [4]. Also: Multiple masters were used to complete the show, including specific matrix segments [4]
- **gd89-12-31.prefm.miller.23574.sbeok.shnf**: source: Pre-FM -> Dat -> Samplitude -> CD -> EAC -> SHN [8]. Also: Charlie Miller's boards are praised for their quality in this recording [26]
- **gd89-12-31.sbd.bertha-ashley.18674.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>>PreFM>>DAT>>CDA>>WAV(EAC)>>SHN>>DAW(Bertha)>>CDA/SHN [13]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - December 31, 1989](https://www.dead.net/show/december-31-1989) [35]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1989-12-31 Grateful Dead Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1989-12-31-grateful-dead-ticket/) [36]
